thread:
caroline: Heads-up — we have a few moving pieces for the dedicated cluster launch. H100 wave 3 is partially delayed (~20 racks). Canary target is still Mar 28. I'm collecting a short owner/blocker list so we can decide scope. Please reply with one-liners: owner, blocker(if any), ETA. Key areas: procurement, cabling/power, OS image bake, network ACLs, reservation allocation, smoke tests.

 tim: Procurement — owner: tim. Blocker: vendor ETA slipped, new ETD 3/25 for last shipment. ETA: 3/26 for racks online (assuming customs clears).

 raja: Cabling/power — owner: raja. Blocker: Need final cable kit (qty 20) from vendor; PO in flight. ETA: 3/27 if PO arrives tomorrow. Also need confirmation of PDU firmware window.

 jess: OS image bake — owner: jess. Blocker: two kernel patches in review (PR #4121). If merged today we can churn images by EOD. ETA: 3/24 otherwise 3/28.

 maya: Network/ACLs — owner: maya. Blocker: one CIDR overlap with customer VPC in staging; working with neteng. ETA: 3/25 to clear.

 deploy-bot: [automated] Reservation created: res-8231a (dedicated-ds-h100-wave3). Link: https://console.internal/reservations/res-8231a

 caroline: Quick ask — can owners add a single-line "fallback" we can flip if timeline slips? e.g., reduce canary nodes from 100 -> 20, or use A100 pool. That helps PM/sales comms.

 tim: Fallback: use pre-provisioned A100 pool (pool-a100-prep). Perf hit ~1.6x latency; OK for canary.

 raja: Fallback: postpone cabling for last 20 racks, proceed with partial rack deployment.

 jess: Fallback: run bake with older kernel (stable-2026-02) until patches merged. Docs: infra/images/stable-2026-02

 maya: I'll add an ACL exception for canary ranges once neteng confirms.

 caroline: Also pinging @infra-oncall — any objections to keeping canary scope but lowering node count? @infra-oncall

 infra-oncall: No objections. Need a runbook update (small delta). If anyone wants, I can schedule a 20m smoke window Tues 09:30.

 caroline: Thanks — last ask: folks please drop a short line in this thread when you push PRs or PO updates so I can stitch into status for PMs. I'll compile and post by EOD.

 jess: PR #4121 merged. Image bake kicked. I'll post artifact id in thread.

 tim: Vendor confirmed customs cleared. ETA racks onsite 3/24. Updating PO status: PO-6679 -> shipped.

 raja: Cable kit PO-998 moved to expedited. Tracking: TRACK-776.

 maya: Neteng cleared CIDR, ACL exception added.

 caroline: Great — I'll assemble final status and post to #eng-platform later today. :thumbsup:
